item.title: CFTC moves to define prediction-market event contracts as swaps, excludes casino-style gambling — Oct 12, 2026 · 10:00 PM ET
item.description: - **CFTC moves to define prediction-market event contracts as swaps, excludes casino-style gambling** — The CFTC on October 9 issued an interim final rule excluding casino-style gambling from the definition of a swap and a companion proposal to explicitly classify event contracts tied to sports, politics, culture and weather as swaps. Chairman Selig says the contracts are commodity derivatives within the agency's exclusive jurisdiction; the move comes as the state-federal fight heads toward the Supreme Court. ([PYMNTS](https://www.pymnts.com/legal/2026/cftc-wants-to-redefine-swaps-to-include-prediction-platforms/))
